title: Moondance
meta_description: Pet Friendly with Pool, Near Beach & Seaside- Moondance by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Moondance by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 25 Cypress Hill Road Details: Moondance is a charming, pet-friendly bungalow tucked away in Old Seagrove Beach, just steps from neighboring Seaside. Designed as a replica of the original Seaside cottages, this classic coastal retreat offers approximately 940 square feet of living space and comfortably accommodates up to 6 guests with three bedrooms and two full baths. A cozy open living area, fully equipped kitchen, and screened porch provide an inviting setting for a relaxed 30A getaway. Outside, enjoy your own private heated pool, outdoor shower, and screened porch surrounded by the laid-back atmosphere of Old Seagrove. Neighborhood beach access is approximately a five-minute walk from the home, while a 90-second walk places you in the heart of Seaside with its restaurants, shopping, and entertainment. With its private pool, pet-friendly accommodations, and exceptional location, Moondance is an ideal retreat for experiencing two of 30A’s most beloved communities. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 5-Minute Walk -Distance to Seaside: Approximately 90-Second Walk -Parking Spaces: (2) -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 6 -Coffee Maker Available -Private Heated Pool: 10’ x 27.5’, 3’–5’ Depth* -*Pet Friendly For Additional Fee -Screened Porch -Outdoor Shower -Outdoor Gas Grill *Pool heat is available for an additional $60 (pre-tax) per night and must be arranged prior to arrival. *Pool heating is not recommended when ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees, as the heater may be unable to reach the desired temperature. *Additional Pet Fee Applicable $350 each (pre-tax) *Please contact Reservations for approval prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 6 3 Bedrooms / 2 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: Queen Bed -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed -Bedroom 3: (2) Twin Beds -(2) Full Baths (Walk-In Showers) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area -Screened Porch -Outdoor Laundry Room with Stackable Washer/Dryer Please Note: *On-street parking is not permitted. *The laundry room is located outside the home and is accessed through a side door. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
